paper_id: Xiao et al. - 2018 - Towards Web-based Delta Synchronization for Cloud Storage Services
title: Towards Web-based Delta Synchronization for Cloud Storage Services
motivation: Web browsers are the most pervasive access method for cloud storage, yet delta sync (节省带宽的关键技术) only available for PC clients and mobile apps, not browsers
problem_framing: JavaScript execution in browsers causes severe stagnation when implementing rsync-style delta sync, making web-based delta sync impractical
key_insight: 通过把计算密集的chunk搜索和比较操作从客户端移到服务器端，同时利用文件编辑的局部性和轻量级哈希算法来优化，实现了web端实用的delta sync
method_signature: WebR2sync+: 反转rsync流程，服务器做chunk搜索匹配，利用局部性跳过搜索，用SipHash替代MD5
evaluation_criteria: 同步耗时、客户端/服务器CPU利用率、浏览器停滞时间、单VM支持的并发客户端数
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: WebRsync的缺陷无法通过纯客户端优化根本解决；Native client需额外安装插件，损害了可用性和普适性；Web workers无法减少总同步时间
evidence_for_taste: can hardly reduce the total sync time
thinking_moves: 先实现naive方案(WebRsync)来理解问题本质
通过性能分解发现瓶颈在客户端JavaScript执行效率
尝试多种客户端优化(Native Client, parallelism, asm.js)均失败
翻转架构思路——把重计算移到服务器端
进一步利用用户文件编辑的局部性特征绕过chunk搜索
用轻量级非加密哈希替代MD5以降低服务器开销
